title: Member Tax Information — How Patronage Is Split among the Member Equities & Patronage Classes and Reported
content:
Patronage allocations of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit are booked to the two Member Equities & Patronage allocated surplus classes, and part of each allocation is declared as cash. This notice gives, for every class, the share of each allocation it receives as cash or as retained surplus, whether allocations are qualified written notices of allocation, the tax form issued and the smallest cash amount paid out.

## Split and reporting by class

| | Class C Participation Certificate | Class A Nonvoting Common Stock | Class B Voting Stock | Qualified Allocated Surplus | Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Class H Preferred Stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Patronage allocations are booked to the class | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Share of each allocation declared as cash and booked as payable on the class (% of the allocation) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 0 | 0 |
| Share of each allocation retained as allocated surplus in the class (% of the allocation) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 20 | 0 |
| Allocations are qualified written notices of allocation (taxable to the member in the year allocated) | No | No | No | Yes | No | No |
| Tax form issued for amounts on the class | None | None | None | 1099-PATR in the year allocated | 1099-PATR in the year redeemed | 1099-DIV |
| Cash patronage below this amount is not paid out but retained in the same class (USD; 0 = not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 10 | 0 | 0 |

## Reading the split

The three shares add to the whole allocation: 50 percent as cash payable on the Qualified Allocated Surplus holding, 30 percent retained in Qualified Allocated Surplus and 20 percent retained in Nonqualified Allocated Surplus.

**Hypothetical illustration.** An allocation of USD 2,000.00 on one loan is booked as USD 1,000.00 of cash payable on the Qualified Allocated Surplus holding, USD 600.00 retained in Qualified Allocated Surplus and USD 400.00 retained in Nonqualified Allocated Surplus. The Qualified amounts are reported on Form 1099-PATR for the year allocated; the Nonqualified amount is reported on Form 1099-PATR in the year it is redeemed.

**Hypothetical illustration of the cash minimum.** On the Qualified Allocated Surplus class, a year's cash of USD 9.40 is below USD 10 and is retained in the same class rather than paid out; a year's cash of USD 10.00 is paid.

Class H Preferred Stock receives no patronage; its dividends are reported on Form 1099-DIV.
